title: Hotel Safe Reset
scenario: A caller claiming to be hotel staff asks for your room safe code to fix an error.

answers.A: Hang up and call the front desk from the room phone or hotel directory.
answers.B: Read the safe code back so staff can reset it.
answers.C: Go to reception and ask staff to check the safe in person.
answers.D: Give only the last digit to prove you are the guest.

explanation: A real staff member can verify the safe without asking for its code over an unexpected call. Treat the code as private.
proTip: The safe code is for the safe, not for telephone verification.
